### PR text

Say what changed and why, how it was checked and what remains (only what is left for the account owner), concisely, for a reviewer who has not seen the conversation. Write it from `git diff <target>...HEAD` (the PR's actual target: the integration base, or its named predecessor in a required stack) and the full commit list, not the last commit, since the PR carries every commit on the branch. Follow the repository's PR template when one exists (`.github/pull_request_template.md` or `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/`), because reviewers expect its sections.
